parts.label: (b)
parts.answer: Reflection in the real axis; $\arg u^*=-\frac{5\pi}{7}$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: B1: Reflection in the real axis (condone x-axis or horizontal axis; must say reflection). B1FT: $\arg u^*=-5\pi/7$ or $2\pi$ minus their exact part (a); a value/expression is required, not merely $\arg u^*=-\arg u$. Total 2.
